name: Jūzō Biwa
background: Jūzō Biwa was one of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist and the original wielder of the Kubikiribōchō. He became a missing-nin and joined the Akatsuki, partnering with Itachi Uchiha during his tenure.

abilities.name: Kubikiribōchō (Executioner's Blade)
abilities.description: A massive sword capable of regenerating itself by absorbing iron from the blood of its victims.

abilities.name: Silent Killing
abilities.description: A technique used by Mist ninja to eliminate targets without making a sound.

abilities.name: Water Release: Water Dragon Bullet Technique
abilities.description: A high-level water release technique that creates a massive water dragon to attack the opponent.

relationships.name: Itachi Uchiha
relationships.dynamic: Partner in the Akatsuki. Itachi and Jūzō worked well together despite their differing styles.

relationships.name: Kirigakure
relationships.dynamic: Formerly loyal to Kirigakure as one of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist before becoming a missing-nin.
